result.rationale: The diff shows `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the raw `fetch` Response when credential sync is active (`return response;` of type `Response` in refreshOAuthTokens.ts), while in normal mode it returns an axios response with `.data`. In zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts the result is immediately used as `if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error)` — a `Response` object has no `.data` property, so `.data` is undefined and `.data.error` throws a TypeError. Same issue affects zoho-bigin and hubspot token handling, confirming the mechanism.

judged_text: In sharing mode zohoCrmTokenInfo is a raw fetch Response, and `if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error)` dereferences the undefined Response.data, throwing TypeError. Under credential sync every Zoho CRM token refresh crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)', breaking Zoho CRM calendar operations in sharing mode.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In sharing mode zohoCrmTokenInfo is a raw fetch Response, and `if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error)` dereferences the undefined Response.data, throwing TypeError. Under credential sync every Zoho CRM token refresh crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)', breaking Zoho CRM calendar operations in sharing mode.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh call was wrapped with `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. That helper returns a `fetch()` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). In that sharing mode, `zohoCrmTokenInfo` will be a `Response`, but the code immediately dereferences `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` (axios-style), which will be `undefined` on a `Response`, causing a runtime `TypeError` when reading `.error`.
